lookback_period_to.description: End value of the lookback period

merge_keys.description: Key columns to uniquely identify records. Required when `write_disposition` is `incremental` or `scd_type_2`

message.description: The message to be sent with the notification

notifications.description: Notifications to be attached to the datamart definition

on_matched_action.description: Behavior when a record with a matching key exists. The following actions are supported: `upsert`, `skip`. Required when `write_disposition` is `incremental`

partitioning.description: The following partitioning types are supported: `ingestion_time`, `time_unit_column`. frequency.description: Frequency of automatic execution. The following frequencies are supported: `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`

hour.description: Value of hour. Required in `daily`, `weekly`, and `monthly` schedules

minute.description: Value of minute. Required for all schedules

time_zone.description: Time zone to be used for calculation

schedules.description: Schedules to be attached to the datamart definition
